rules.criterion: Every factual claim needs source support; unknown facts stay unknown.
Questions, hypotheses and requested improvements are not established facts.
Unconfirmed publication permission blocks public release; confidentiality is not guessed.
Preserve stable matter identity and distinguish duplicate references from different mandates.
Practice relevance depends on the legal mandate, not the industry or prestige of the client.
Describe the firm’s actual contribution, not merely the client’s business activity.
Preserve pending status, dates, negation, currency and material conflicts; never infer victories or conversions.
Do not infer or guarantee a ranking from practice area, firm name, matter count or deal size.
A mention of a lawyer does not establish lead responsibility, partner status or ranking.
Submission, internal letter and Studio must share one canonical selection and hero decision.
Document completeness, evidence quality and editorial quality are different; do not invent a composite certification score.
Keep internal gaps and audit commentary out of public submission prose.
Repairs must be targeted and bounded; an unresolved critical defect blocks delivery.
Do not pad a portfolio or narrative to reach a matter or word quota.
Review the actual rendered artifact and invalidate approval after input changes.
